resources.contents:
openapi: "3.0.0"

info:
  title: Edubit API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: OpenAPI spec for Edubit's participants
  contact:
    name: HMCA

tags:
  - name: Participants
    description: All operations related with Participants
  - name: Mentors
    description: All operations related with Participants

components:
  schemas:
    PersistentParticipant:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        roles:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        parentEmail:
          type: string
          format: email
        parentPhone:
          type: integer
        activities:
          type: string
          format: JSON
        enabled:
          type: boolean
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        disabledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - email
        - roles
        - parentEmail
        - parentPhone
        - enabled
        - creationDate
    PersistentMentor:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        roles:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        phone:
          type: integer
        activities:
          type: object
          format: JSON
        enabled:
          type: boolean
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        disabledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
        - id
        - roles
        - name
        - email
        - phone
        - enabled
        - creationDate

servers:
  - url: https://{gateway}.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/{stage}
    description: URL on AWS cloud
    variables:
      gateway:
        enum: [ar0elk0gz9]
        default: ar0elk0gz9
      stage:
        enum: [dev, qa, live]
        default: dev

paths:
  /participants/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get participant
      description: Get all information of a participant, without security information
      operationId: getParticipant
      tags:
        - Participants
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Participant successfully retrieved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentParticipant'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
    patch:
      summary: Update participant
      description: Updates partial information of a participant (grade, phone, activities, parentPhone, parentEmail)
      operationId: updateParticipant
      tags:
        - Participants
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentParticipant'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Participant successfully updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentParticipant'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
    delete:
      summary: Disables participant
      description: Makes a logical deletion of a participant
      operationId: deleteParticipant
      tags:
        - Participants
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Participant successfully disabled
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /mentors/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get mentor
      description: Get all information of a mentor
      operationId: getMentor
      tags:
        - Mentors
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Mentor successfully retrieved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentMentor'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
    patch:
      summary: Update mentor
      description: Updates partial information of a mentor (phone, activities)
      operationId: updateMentor
      tags:
        - Mentors
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentMentor'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Participant successfully updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentMentor'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
    delete:
      summary: Disable mentor
      description: Makes a logical deletion of a participant
      operationId: deleteMentor
      tags:
        - Mentors
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Participant successfully disabled
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
